part_bytes.description: Every part except the last MUST be exactly this size (>= 5 MiB).

received_parts.description: Part numbers already stored (resume by sending the others).

transfer.description: node: parts go to PUT /uploads/{id}/parts/{n} on the node. direct: bytes go straight to storage through presigned URLs (capability ingest.direct_upload, proposal 0008). Absent = node.

mode.description: Direct uploads only: one PUT to `put`, or one PUT per part to `part_urls`.

url.description: Presigned storage URL (https). Send the bytes with PUT, exactly the headers in `headers`, and never the ingest token.

headers.description: Headers the signature covers (at least Content-Length; Content-Type for a single PUT). Send them exactly.

put.description: Direct single upload: where to PUT the whole file.

part_urls.description: Direct multipart upload: a presigned URL for every part not yet received (fresh on every GET). Every part except the last is exactly part_bytes.

url.description: Presigned storage URL (https). Send the bytes with PUT, exactly the headers in `headers`, and never the ingest token.

headers.description: Headers the signature covers (at least Content-Length; Content-Type for a single PUT). Send them exactly.
